doc.title: Louis Armstrong and Herman Chittison Interview, 1960-05-04

title: Why he went to Europe and how he got the name Satchmo
summary: Armstrong says he wanted to go blow for them, first stopping in London. A British editor greeted him at Plymouth with 'Satchmo', which stuck.
